title: Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services Tariff Card: Engagement Fees by Service
content:
# Tariff Card: Engagement Fees by Service

Every engagement under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services is quoted on the fees below. Each service carries its own base fee, its own per-item fee, its own minimum fee, its own allowance of appraiser hours and its own ceiling on how many pieces one engagement may cover. All money figures are in USD.

| Service | Base fee | Per-item fee, each piece beyond the first | Minimum fee | Appraiser hours included in the base fee | Hourly rate beyond the included hours | Pieces one engagement may cover |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | 125 | 65 | 125 | 1 | 145 | 5 |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | 175 | 85 | 175 | 2 | 165 | 10 |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | 250 | 110 | 350 | 3 | 195 | 40 |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | 395 | 250 | 395 | 2 | 225 | 3 |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | 850 | 95 | 1500 | 8 | 295 | 250 |

## Reading the columns

- **Base fee** is the fee for the engagement itself, before any per-item charge is added.
- **Per-item fee** is charged once for each piece beyond the first piece on the engagement; the first piece is covered by the base fee.
- **Minimum fee** is the smallest total fee any engagement of that service carries, whatever the count of pieces.
- **Appraiser hours included** are the hours of appraiser time the base fee already pays for; the **hourly rate** is charged per hour of appraiser time beyond that allowance.
- **Pieces one engagement may cover** is the ceiling on the number of pieces a single engagement of that service takes in.

## Points of reading

- A Verbal Counter Estimate carries no fee under any column and covers one piece only.
- The Estate and Probate Appraisal is the one service whose minimum fee, 350, stands above its base fee, 250; at the other five services the minimum fee equals the base fee.
- A collection of 12 pieces cannot sit on one Fair Market Value Appraisal engagement, whose ceiling is 10 pieces; the Estate and Probate Appraisal takes up to 40 pieces on one engagement and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal up to 250.
- The Certified Gemological Laboratory Report carries the highest per-item fee on the card, 250, and covers no more than 3 pieces on one engagement.
